nights.title: Chief Keef
nights.name: Chief Keef
nights.extract: Keith Farrelle Cozart, known professionally as Chief Keef, is an American rapper and record producer. Beginning his career as a teenager, he gained regional recognition for his mixtapes in the early 2010s. Cozart has since been credited with popularizing the hip hop subgenre drill among mainstream audiences and is considered a progenitor of the genre.

en.who: Keith Farrelle Cozart, known professionally as Chief Keef, is an American rapper and record producer. Beginning his career as a teenager, he gained regional recognition for his mixtapes in the early 2010s.
facts: Beginning his career as a teenager, he gained regional recognition for his mixtapes in the early 2010s.
Cozart has since been credited with popularizing the hip hop subgenre drill among mainstream audiences and is considered a progenitor of the genre.

de.who: Keith Farrelle Cozart, künstlerisch bekannt als Chief Keef, ist ein amerikanischer Rapper und Musikproduzent. Er begann seine Karriere als Teenager.
facts: Mit seinen Mixtapes erlangte er in den frühen 2010er-Jahren zunächst regionale Anerkennung, als er noch Teenager war.
Cozart wird inzwischen die Popularisierung des Hip-Hop-Subgenres Drill beim Mainstream-Publikum zugeschrieben; er gilt als Wegbereiter des Genres.

tr.who: Sahne adı Chief Keef olan Keith Farrelle Cozart, Amerikalı bir rapçi ve plak yapımcısıdır. Genç yaşta kariyerine başladı.
facts: Kariyerine genç yaşta başladı ve 2010'ların başında mixtapeleriyle bölgesel tanınırlık kazandı.
Cozart, drill alt türünü ana akım kitleler arasında yaygınlaştırmakla anılıyor ve bu türün öncülerinden biri sayılıyor.

nights.title: Robert Glasper
nights.name: Robert Glasper
nights.extract: Robert Andre Glasper is an American pianist, record producer, songwriter, and musical arranger. His music embodies numerous musical genres, primarily centered on jazz. Glasper has won five Grammy Awards from 11 nominations.

en.kicker: american jazz pianist, producer and songwriter

facts: His music embodies numerous musical genres, primarily centered on jazz.

de.who: Robert Andre Glasper ist ein amerikanischer Pianist, Musikproduzent, Songwriter und Arrangeur. Er hat fünf Grammy Awards gewonnen.
facts: Seine Musik umfasst zahlreiche Genres, wobei der Jazz im Mittelpunkt steht.

tr.who: Robert Andre Glasper, Amerikalı bir piyanist, plak yapımcısı, söz yazarı ve aranjördür. Beş Grammy Ödülü kazanmıştır.

Glasper, on bir adaylıktan beş Grammy Ödülü kazandı.

nights.title: Mike Dawes
nights.name: Mike Dawes
nights.extract: Michael Kenneth James Dawes is an English fingerstyle guitar player known for composing, arranging, and performing multiple parts simultaneously on the guitar. As of 2025, he has released four studio albums, one live record, one EP, and numerous singles.

en.who: Michael Kenneth James Dawes is an English fingerstyle guitar player known for composing, arranging, and performing multiple parts simultaneously on the guitar.
facts: As of 2025, he has released four studio albums, one live record, one EP, and numerous singles.
He is known for composing, arranging, and performing multiple parts simultaneously on the guitar.

de.who: Michael Kenneth James Dawes ist ein englischer Fingerstyle-Gitarrist. Er ist dafür bekannt, mehrere Stimmen gleichzeitig auf der Gitarre zu komponieren, zu arrangieren und zu spielen.
facts: Seit 2025 hat er vier Studioalben, ein Live-Album, eine EP und zahlreiche Singles veröffentlicht.
Er ist dafür bekannt, mehrere Stimmen gleichzeitig auf der Gitarre zu komponieren, zu arrangieren und zu spielen.

tr.who: Michael Kenneth James Dawes, İngiliz bir fingerstyle gitarcıdır. Gitarda aynı anda birden fazla parçayı besteleyip düzenleyerek ve icra ederek tanınır.
facts: 2025 itibarıyla dört stüdyo albümü, bir canlı kayıt, bir EP ve çok sayıda single yayımladı.
Gitarda aynı anda birden fazla parçayı besteleyip düzenleme ve çalma konusunda tanınır.
